title: Restricted Recipient (Lock-In) Program Description — PrairieRx
content:
**Program rule of the Pharmacy Benefit.** A member of a lock-in eligible PrairieRx plan who used at least the plan's trigger number of prescribers or the plan's trigger number of pharmacies for controlled substances within 90 days may be locked in to one pharmacy and one prescriber for the plan's lock-in months after the plan's notice days of written notice. During lock-in any fill at another pharmacy rejects with the reject reason "lock-in pharmacy mismatch", and a controlled substance from another prescriber rejects with "lock-in prescriber mismatch", except an emergency fill where the plan allows the emergency override and the lock-in pharmacy is closed or out of stock. The member may change the lock-in pharmacy for member preference only while the member-preference changes counted in the rolling window are below the plan's allowance of lock-in pharmacy changes per 12 months; a change because the member moved or the pharmacy closed is always allowed and is logged with that reason. A lock-in ends on the lock-in end date and is never extended without a new review and notice.

### Who may be locked in

Both of the following: the member's plan is lock-in eligible; and within 90 days the member used at least the plan's trigger number of prescribers **or** at least the plan's trigger number of pharmacies for controlled substances. Lock-in then starts only after the plan's notice days of written notice.

### Fills during lock-in

| Fill during lock-in | Result |
|---|---|
| Any drug at the lock-in pharmacy, from the lock-in prescriber | Not rejected by the lock-in |
| Any drug at another pharmacy | Rejected, lock-in pharmacy mismatch — unless an emergency fill where the plan allows it and the lock-in pharmacy is closed or out of stock |
| Controlled substance from another prescriber | Rejected, lock-in prescriber mismatch — unless the same emergency exception applies |

### Changing the lock-in pharmacy

The count uses the lock-in pharmacy changes logged on the member's coverage with the reason "member preference" in the rolling 365 calendar days that end on the day of the request, that day included. The check reads the system record of the coverage and its current lock-in pharmacy before the change.

| Reason for the change | Member-preference changes already in the window | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Member preference | Below the plan's allowance | Allowed, logged as member preference |
| Member preference | At or above the plan's allowance | Not allowed |
| The member moved | any | Always allowed, logged as member moved |
| The pharmacy closed | any | Always allowed, logged as pharmacy closed |

*Hypothetical example:* on a plan allowing 1 member-preference change in 12 months, a member who changed pharmacy for preference 200 days ago is at the allowance and may not change again for preference; the same member may still change because the lock-in pharmacy closed.

### End of lock-in

A lock-in ends on its lock-in end date. It is never extended without a new review and a new notice.
